description:
The Huffy So Sweet 16-inch bike is designed for kids ages 4–6 who are typically between 42 and 48 inches tall. Its kid-friendly steel frame and just-right sizing help young riders feel balanced, steady, and excited to ride.
Removable training wheels give beginners the support they need while learning, then come off easily as skills improve. Paired with a simple coaster brake, kids can focus on pedaling, steering, and stopping with confidence.
A padded saddle and soft, easy-to-hold grips are designed for small hands and growing riders. Smooth-rolling tires help every ride feel comfortable from the first push to the last lap.
From the glossy white frame to the rose pink accents and holographic graphics, this bike shines with personality. It’s a look kids are proud to show off and parents feel great choosing.

components.description: Easy Coaster Brake: Simple rear braking lets kids stop safely by pedaling backward, perfect for early riders.
